features.name: Barcode Scanning
features.description: Enable users to scan product barcodes for quick inventory updates and lookups.
user_stories: As a store clerk, I can scan product barcodes so that I can quickly add items to inventory.
As a store manager, I can scan barcodes to verify stock levels so that I can make informed ordering decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid barcode, When the user scans it, Then the product details are displayed within 2 seconds.
Given an invalid barcode, When the user scans it, Then an error message is shown indicating the product is not found.

features.name: Real-Time Inventory Tracking
features.description: Track inventory levels in real-time as products are added, sold, or removed.
user_stories: As a store owner, I can view real-time inventory levels so that I know what products are in stock.
As a store clerk, I can update inventory quantities so that stock levels remain accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product sale, When the transaction is completed, Then the inventory count decreases immediately.
Given multiple users updating inventory, When changes are made, Then all users see synchronized data within 3 seconds.

features.name: Low Stock Alerts
features.description: Automatically notify users when product inventory falls below predefined thresholds.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can receive alerts for low stock items so that I can reorder before running out.
As a store owner, I can set custom threshold levels so that alerts match my business needs.
acceptance_criteria: Given inventory below threshold, When stock level is updated, Then an alert notification is sent to designated users.
Given a threshold setting, When the manager updates it, Then future alerts use the new threshold value.

features.name: Product Management
features.description: Add, edit, and remove products with details like name, price, category, and supplier information.
user_stories: As a store manager, I can add new products to the system so that they are available for inventory tracking.
As a store owner, I can edit product details so that information remains current and accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid product details, When the manager submits the form, Then the product is saved and appears in the inventory list.
Given an existing product, When the user updates its details, Then changes are reflected immediately across the system.

features.name: Sales Reporting
features.description: Generate reports showing sales trends, top-selling products, and revenue over time.
user_stories: As a store owner, I can view sales reports so that I can analyze business performance.
As a store manager, I can filter reports by date range so that I can track specific periods.
acceptance_criteria: Given a date range selection, When the user generates a report, Then sales data for that period is displayed accurately.
Given sales transactions, When the report is generated, Then top-selling products are ranked correctly by quantity sold.
